lead: The old village of Les Corts: squares, a market and neighbourhood life beside the Diagonal.
text: Les Corts keeps the layout of its old centre, with Plaça de la Concòrdia at its heart and the Mercat de les Corts as a meeting point, and opens to the north onto Avinguda Diagonal, with its offices and shopping centres.

With 46,672 inhabitants in 1.41 km², it is a lived-in, well-equipped neighbourhood, with local shops, schools and good transport links. At 5,162 €/m² and 1,299 €/month, it is the second most expensive neighbourhood in the district, behind Pedralbes.
housing: Low-rise houses in the old centre and taller blocks of flats, especially beside the Diagonal.
